name: What are the most common mistakes in guest bathroom remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause guest bathroom remodels to go over budget or look unfinished?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause guest bathroom remodels to go over budget or look unfinished?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guest bathroom remodels go wrong when homeowners focus only on finishes and ignore function, sequencing, and hidden conditions. The most common mistake is changing the layout without a clear reason, because plumbing relocation and patching can drive up cost quickly. Another frequent problem is underestimating what demolition may reveal, especially in older Los Angeles homes where leaks, mold, or outdated systems are common. Oversized vanities, bulky shower enclosures, and heavy visual patterns can make a small bath feel tighter rather than better. Skipping ventilation or weak lighting also hurts the final result. Good planning should include storage, tile transitions, waterproofing, and how the room will feel after the remodel is complete, not just how it looks on a rendering. A successful guest bathroom is usually simple, balanced, and practical.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most common mistakes are changing the layout too late, underestimating hidden plumbing or waterproofing issues, choosing oversized fixtures for a small room, and skipping ventilation or lighting upgrades. Poor planning on tile, niches, and storage can also make the finished bathroom feel cramped or incomplete.
